Question 4(b) [4 marks]: Describe the importance of monitoring and controlling for this manufacturer.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
A television manufacturer has been experiencing problems with poor quality raw materials and delays in delivery times to customers. As a result their production has slowed, profits are down and customers are complaining.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
3–4 marks: Provides characteristics and features of monitoring and controlling relevant to the television manufacturer
2 marks: May provide some characteristics and features of monitoring and controlling, may relate to the television manufacturer
1 marks: Outlines monitoring OR controlling

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Monitoring is the process of measuring actual versus planned performance using KPIs (defect rates, turnover rates). Control occurs when predetermined targets are compared to results and corrective action is taken. It indicates any issues and enables managers to change the operations process, for example changing the level of technology to correct the problem.


TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
Students needed to define monitoring and controlling correctly and relate them to the TV manufacturer for full marks. Many could say how these would impact manufacturing but did not identify what they were.
